{{Top|leg}}
'''Kaadu-and-aliens''' was a game practiced by the [[Youngling/Legends|children]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. It involved holding both [[Limb/Legends|arms]] level from the elbows, with the hands doubled into fists, save for extended index fingers.

==Appearances==
*''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''
